name: Challenging

blockers.description: Critical integration tests are excluded from CI test execution via pytest marker filter flag (-m 'not integration'), leaving the integration path unverified despite green CI.

acceptable_extra_findings.note: Observation categorizing the pytest marker exclusion under CI configuration.

forbidden_findings.note: Claiming integration tests ran successfully is false.

notes: Flagship held-out case. CI conclusion is success and test_report has 0 failures, but integration tests are excluded by workflow filter (-m 'not integration') and omitted from test_report.
